## check
z=example.org&r=is+@+MX+0+.&r=is+@+TXT+%22v=spf1+-all%22&r=is+_dmarc+TXT+%22v=DMARC1;+p=reject%22&r=is+@+CAA+0+issue+%22;%22&r=is+*._domainkey+TXT+%22v=DKIM1;+p=%22
## bind
; DNS change request for example.org (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.org.

; example.org MX
; replaces every MX record of @
@ 3600 IN MX 0 .

; example.org TXT (SPF); the other TXT records of @ stay
; replaces the SPF record of @
@ 3600 IN TXT "v=spf1 -all"

; _dmarc.example.org TXT (DMARC); the other TXT records of _dmarc stay
; replaces the DMARC record of _dmarc
_dmarc 3600 IN TXT "v=DMARC1; p=reject"

; example.org CAA
; replaces every CAA record of @
@ 3600 IN CAA 0 issue ";"

; *._domainkey.example.org TXT (DKIM); the other TXT records of *._domainkey stay
; replaces the DKIM record of *._domainkey
*._domainkey 3600 IN TXT "v=DKIM1; p="
## route53
{
  "Comment": "DNS change request for example.org (DomainScope)",
  "Changes": [

        "TTL": 3600,

## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.org (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.org}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. Delete the example.org MX records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=MX&name=example.org" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 2. Add example.org MX 0 .
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"MX","name":"example.org","content":".","priority":0,"ttl":3600}'

# 3. Delete the example.org TXT (SPF) records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=TXT&name=example.org" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 4. Add example.org TXT "v=spf1 -all"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"example.org","content":"\"v=spf1 -all\"","ttl":3600}'

# 5. Delete the _dmarc.example.org TXT (DMARC) records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=TXT&name=_dmarc.example.org" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 6. Add _dmarc.example.org TXT "v=DMARC1; p=reject"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"_dmarc.example.org","content":"\"v=DMARC1; p=reject\"","ttl":3600}'

# 7. Delete the example.org CAA records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=CAA&name=example.org" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 8. Add example.org CAA 0 issue ";"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"CAA","name":"example.org","data":{"flags":0,"tag":"issue","value":";"},"ttl":3600}'

# 9. Delete the *._domainkey.example.org TXT (DKIM) records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=TXT&name=*._domainkey.example.org" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 10. Add *._domainkey.example.org TXT "v=DKIM1; p="
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"*._domainkey.example.org","content":"\"v=DKIM1; p=\"","ttl":3600}'
## cloudflare notes
fix.fn.cloudflare-ids {}
## octodns
# DNS change request for example.org (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.org.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
---
'':
  - type: MX
    ttl: 3600
    values:
      - exchange: '.'
        preference: 0
  # keep the other TXT values this name has; replace its SPF value with the one below
  - type: TXT
    ttl: 3600
    values:
      - 'v=spf1 -all'
  - type: CAA
    ttl: 3600
    values:
      - flags: 0
        tag: issue
        value: ';'
_dmarc:
  # keep the other TXT values this name has; replace its DMARC value with the one below
  - type: TXT
    ttl: 3600
    values:
      - 'v=DMARC1\; p=reject'
'*._domainkey':
  # keep the other TXT values this name has; replace its DKIM value with the one below
  - type: TXT
    ttl: 3600
    values:
      - 'v=DKIM1\; p='
## octodns notes

fix.fn.incomplete {"name":"*._domainkey.example.org","type":"TXT"}
## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.org (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.org"
}

# remove the resources of any other example.org MX record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "mx_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.org"
  type     = "MX"
  content  = "."
  priority = 0
  ttl      = 3600
}

# remove the resources of any other example.org TXT (SPF) record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.org"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "v=spf1 -all"
  ttl      = 3600
}

# remove the resources of any other _dmarc.example.org TXT (DMARC) record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_dmarc" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "_dmarc.example.org"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "v=DMARC1; p=reject"
  ttl      = 3600
}

# remove the resources of any other example.org CAA record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "caa_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.org"
  type     = "CAA"
  data {
    flags = 0
    tag   = "issue"
    value = ";"
  }
  ttl      = 3600
}

# remove the resources of any other *._domainkey.example.org TXT (DKIM) record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_wildcard_domainkey" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "*._domainkey.example.org"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "v=DKIM1; p="
  ttl      = 3600
}
## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.org (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.org"
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "mx_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.org"
  type    = "MX"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["0 ."]
}

# list the other TXT values of example.org here too (they were not read): this resource replaces the whole set

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.org"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["v=spf1 -all"]
}

# list the other TXT values of _dmarc.example.org here too (they were not read): this resource replaces the whole set

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_dmarc" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "_dmarc.example.org"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["v=DMARC1; p=reject"]
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "caa_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.org"
  type    = "CAA"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["0 issue \";\""]
}

# list the other TXT values of *._domainkey.example.org here too (they were not read): this resource replaces the whole set

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_wildcard_domainkey" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "*._domainkey.example.org"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["v=DKIM1; p="]
}

## en
DNS change request: example.org

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.org. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Replace: MX records
   Name: example.org
   Value:
     0 .
   TTL: 3600
   Replace every MX record of the name with the values above.
2. Replace: SPF record (TXT)
   Name: example.org
   Value:
     "v=spf1 -all"
   TTL: 3600
   Replace the name’s SPF record with the value above.
   The other TXT records of the name stay as they are.
3. Replace: DMARC record (TXT)
   Name: _dmarc.example.org
   Value:
     "v=DMARC1; p=reject"
   TTL: 3600
   Replace the name’s DMARC record with the value above.
   The other TXT records of the name stay as they are.
4. Replace: CAA records
   Name: example.org
   Value:
     0 issue ";"
   TTL: 3600
   Replace every CAA record of the name with the values above.
5. Replace: DKIM record (TXT)
   Name: *._domainkey.example.org
   Value:
     "v=DKIM1; p="
   TTL: 3600
   Replace the name’s DKIM record with the value above.
   The other TXT records of the name stay as they are.

Notes:
- Only for a domain that sends and receives no mail and needs no certificate: all mail as the domain is rejected and every CA refuses to issue.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.org&r=is+@+MX+0+.&r=is+@+TXT+%22v=spf1+-all%22&r=is+_dmarc+TXT+%22v=DMARC1;+p=reject%22&r=is+@+CAA+0+issue+%22;%22&r=is+*._domainkey+TXT+%22v=DKIM1;+p=%22
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.org

Lütfen example.org DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. Değiştir: MX kayıtları
   Ad: example.org
   Değer:
     0 .
   TTL: 3600
   Adın tüm MX kayıtlarını yukarıdaki değerlerle değiştirin.
2. Değiştir: SPF kaydı (TXT)
   Ad: example.org
   Değer:
     "v=spf1 -all"
   TTL: 3600
   Adın SPF kaydını yukarıdaki değerle değiştirin.
   Adın diğer TXT kayıtları olduğu gibi kalır.
3. Değiştir: DMARC kaydı (TXT)
   Ad: _dmarc.example.org
   Değer:
     "v=DMARC1; p=reject"
   TTL: 3600
   Adın DMARC kaydını yukarıdaki değerle değiştirin.
   Adın diğer TXT kayıtları olduğu gibi kalır.
4. Değiştir: CAA kayıtları
   Ad: example.org
   Değer:
     0 issue ";"
   TTL: 3600
   Adın tüm CAA kayıtlarını yukarıdaki değerlerle değiştirin.
5. Değiştir: DKIM kaydı (TXT)
   Ad: *._domainkey.example.org
   Değer:
     "v=DKIM1; p="
   TTL: 3600
   Adın DKIM kaydını yukarıdaki değerle değiştirin.
   Adın diğer TXT kayıtları olduğu gibi kalır.

Notlar:
- Yalnızca e-posta almayan, göndermeyen ve sertifika gerektirmeyen bir alan adı için: alan adı adına tüm e-postalar reddedilir ve her otorite sertifika vermeyi reddeder.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.org&r=is+@+MX+0+.&r=is+@+TXT+%22v=spf1+-all%22&r=is+_dmarc+TXT+%22v=DMARC1;+p=reject%22&r=is+@+CAA+0+issue+%22;%22&r=is+*._domainkey+TXT+%22v=DKIM1;+p=%22
